newsitem.title: USA: Southern Energy Homes sees Q2 $0.21-$0.25.
newsitem.headline: Southern Energy Homes sees Q2 $0.21-$0.25.

text.p: Southern Energy Homes Inc said Thursday it expects second quarter net of $0.21-$0.25, or about 22 percent below analysts' estimates, because of increased competition and bad weather.
The company also said it expects to post second quarter manufacturing revenues of $72 million, 14 percent below analysts' estimates.

The company said low backlogs due to increased capacity and higher inventory levels make it difficult to accurately predict at this time whether the company will be able to meet previous projections for manufacturing revenues and net income for the full 1997 fiscal year.

The company attributed the decline in projected manufacturing revenue to reduced shipments resulting from higher dealer inventory levels, which in turn were caused by unfavorable weather and other factors.

"Southern Energy, as well as the entire industry, has been hard hit by the current market softness. We are taking the necessary actions to maximize shareholder value and to fully participate in the industry going forward," said chief executive Wendell Batchelor.
